facts.fact: The twelve redbark packets are small palm-sized bundles of waxed paper tied with thread, laid in three rows of four inside the oilcloth roll at the bottom of Meera's pack.
facts.why: needed because Rohan sees and counts them on the page.

facts.fact: Meera and Rohan bet on whether he can stay silent for an hour; the stake is the loser's sattu at the next halt, which Rohan wins and will collect then.
facts.why: needed because the outline calls for the bet and a stake must be named.

facts.fact: A waystone stands at the foot of the climb to the Long Saddle: a squat grey pillar with a shelf of flat stones left by earlier crossers. Meera builds a three-stone cairn there for Jassi.
facts.why: needed because the outline sets the closing scene at the waystone below the Long Saddle.

facts.fact: Because Meera's fingertips are white from the demonstration lie for an hour, Rohan notes they cannot testify to anything she says during that hour.
facts.why: needed because it follows from the small-lie rule and shapes his reading of her truthful answers.
